applies_why: The judge text expressly notes that hēs was answered, which invokes the rule's treatment of an answered verse.
quote: and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge does not count the answered hēs verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link, so it obeys K-G4.
